headline: Approved amendments to Chapter 117-Animals and reappointed Timothy R. Creamer as Constable, both 3-0.
summary: The committee approved proposed amendments to Chapter 117-Animals, Order #058A, adding a new section on feeding wild animals, with changes made during the meeting. The committee also approved the reappointment of Timothy R. Creamer, 36 Appleton Avenue, to serve as Constable, Order #112.
decisions: Approved reappointment of Timothy R. Creamer, 36 Appleton Avenue, as Constable, Order #112, 3-0.
Approved motion to strike section 117-21 from the amendments to Order #058A, 3-0.
Approved motion to accept Solicitor Dole's suggested wording for section A of the amendment, 3-0.
transcript:
Todd C. Rotondo, Chair
Matthew J. St. Hilaire
Steven M. Crowley

## Legal Affairs /Committee of the Whole Meeting Minutes
### Conference Room A
### Monday, April 06, 2026, 6:00 PM
### Beverly City Hall, 3rd Floor, 191 Cabot Street

Present: Rotondo, Crowley and St. Hilaire
Also Present: Solicitor Oldmixon, Assistant Solicitor Dole, Animal Control Officer Lapinski.
Committee of the Whole-Spang, Houseman arrived at 6:10PM.

| Order Number | Date to Committee | Description | Action Taken |
|---|---|---|---|
| #058A | 3/16/2026 | Assistant City Solicitor Dole-Proposed amendments to Chapter 117-Animals to add a new Chapter V titled Feeding of Wild Animals and /pr Wildlife. | A 3-0 |
| #112 | 3/16/2026 | A reappointment for Timothy R. Creamer, 36 Appleton Avenue to serve as Constable | A 3-0 |

Chair Rotondo called the meeting to order at 6:00 PM.
Called to order Committee of the Whole 6:02 PM.

Order #058A-Discussion regarding the amendments to the order.

St. Hilaire-Can we strike 117-21 all together?

Dole-If that is the motion feel free to do it.

Crowley-Motion to strike 117-21 from the amendments to order #058A. 117-22 becomes 117-21.
St. Hilaire-Second.
Approved 3-0

Rotondo-Can we strike publicly under "A"?

Oldmixon-I would suggest keeping it publicly or within X amount of feet.

Rotondo-How do we say it directly? "add" under section A "Birds only fed by birdfeeders"?

Dole-Suggests amending A to "No person shall intentionally feed, bait, or in any manner access to food to any wild animal or birds within the city of Beverly on lands either publicly or privately owned. Birds shall only be fed from the bird feeders"

St. Hilaire-Motion to accept Solicitor Doles suggestions.
Crowley- Second. Motion approved 3-0

Legal Affairs adjourned at 6:09 PM Committee of the Whole adjourned at 6:09 PM.
